movelist.name: Roost
movelist.effect: The user regains Hit Points equal to half of its full Hit Points. If the user is a Flying Type, it loses the Flying Type until the start of their next turn.

movelist.name: Take Down
movelist.effect: You may perform a Trip Maneuver against the target as a Free Action.

movelist.name: Ancient Power
movelist.effect: On 19+, the user has each of its stats raised by +1 Combat Stage.

movelist.name: Yawn
movelist.effect: The target falls Asleep at the end of their next turn. Yawn cannot miss.

movelist.name: Screech
movelist.effect: All Legal Targets have their Defense lowered 2 Combat Stages.

movelist.name: Pursuit
movelist.effect: If the foe is fleeing or being switched out, Pursuit may be used as an Interrupt, targeting the triggering foe. When used as an Interrupt, Pursuit grants the user a +5 bonus to all Movement Speeds, and has a Damage Base of 8 (2d8+10 / 19).

abilities.name: Run Away
abilities.effect: The user does not provoke Attacks of Opportunity by Shifting.  The user cannot be Trapped.

abilities.name: Serene Grace
abilities.effect: The user’s Effect Range is increased by +2.
